channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals

item.title: Top Pick: Saladworks: 40th Anniversary Create Your Own Bowl or Wrap for $6.99
item.guid: Saladworks-40th Anniversary Create Your Own Bowl or-2026-10-25
item.description: To celebrate its 40th anniversary, Saladworks is offering Create Your Own Bowls and Wraps starting at $6.99 at participating locations through today, October 25. (Northeast & Mid-Atlantic only) (Through October 25, 2026)

item.title: Top Pick: Tropical Smoothie Cafe: $2 24oz Smoothie with Any Food or Bowl Purchase
item.guid: Tropical Smoothie Cafe-$2 24oz Smoothie with Any Food or Bowl P-2026-10-25
item.description: Get a $2 24oz smoothie with the purchase of any regular-priced food item or Tropic Bowl using a promo code at checkout, available Sundays and Mondays at participating locations. (Sundays and Mondays only)

item.title: Subway: BOGO 50% Off Footlongs with Code BOGO50
item.guid: Subway-BOGO 50% Off Footlongs with Code BOGO50-2026-10-25
item.description: Buy one footlong online or in the Subway app and get a second 50% off with code BOGO50 at participating locations. Listed by The Krazy Coupon Lady on October 2, 2026; the code has run since summer and may end without notice, so enter it before paying. (Limited time)

item.title: Noodles & Company: $3 Off Any Ramen Entree with Code 3OFFRAMEN
item.guid: Noodles & Company-$3 Off Any Ramen Entree with Code 3OFFRA-2026-10-25
item.description: Use code 3OFFRAMEN for $3 off any regular-sized ramen entree such as Gochujang Carbonara or Spicy Korean Steak Ramen, limited to the first 222,000 redemptions. (Through November 15, 2026)

item.title: El Pollo Loco: Fire-Grilled Combos from $5.99: Pollo Bowl, Chicken Burrito or 3 Tacos al Carbon with Chips and a Drink
item.guid: El Pollo Loco-Fire-Grilled Combos from $5.99: Pollo Bo-2026-10-25
item.description: El Pollo Loco's value combos (Original Pollo Bowl, Classic Chicken Burrito, 3 Tacos al Carbon) come with chips and a regular drink for $5.99 to $6.99 at a Los Angeles store on order.elpolloloco.com, checked October 3, 2026. The chain advertised them at $5 through 2022; prices vary by market. (West & Southwest only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Publix: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
item.guid: Publix-Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's -2026-10-25
item.description: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it. (FL & Southeast only) (Ongoing (changes weekly))

item.title: Naf Naf Grill: $9.99 Pita Meal Deal
item.guid: Naf Naf Grill-$9.99 Pita Meal Deal-2026-10-25
item.description: Naf Naf Grill's value menu: a full pita meal for $9.99, in store and in the app, every day at participating locations. (Midwest & East only) (Ongoing)
